articles.title: A Trader’s Guide to Venezuela as Trump Eyes Its Oil
articles.mainIdea: A Trader’s Guide to Venezuela as Trump Eyes Its Oil
articles.summary: Bloomberg: A Trader’s Guide to Venezuela as Trump Eyes Its Oil. For investors hoping to get in on the bonanza, however, the calculus isn’t so simple. “Right now, global capital spending in oil is declining because supply is abundant and demand is lower than expected,” said Edward Morse, adviser to Hartree Partners and former global head of commodities research at Citigroup Inc. “Venezuela is trying to reopen during a down cycle rather than an up cycle.” Below is a guide to how investors are approaching the sudden opportunity set created by Trump’s decision to topple Nicolás Maduro, the longtime leader of Venezuela, and lay claim to what is purported to be the world’s largest oil reserves.
